todaysEvents.delta: Vance told reporters Sep 3 Iran's Hormuz control is 'effectively gone,' a 'diminishing asset,' ruling out talks unless Iran halts shipping attacks (Time, Washington Times); Kpler data show only ~5 transits Sep 1 vs a 10-day average of ~14.

todaysEvents.summary: Sirik wedding toll confirmed at 4-5 dead
todaysEvents.delta: Hormozgan officials named four victims, including a 4-year-old, from the Sep 1 US strike on a Kuhestak wedding, with 60+ wounded (Al Jazeera); Vance voiced 'extreme skepticism' of the Iranian account, CENTCOM reviewing.
Brent held $95.81 (-0.12%) and WTI $91.82 (+0.32%) on Sep 3 (Trading Economics); TTF eased to 71.15 EUR/MWh (-0.92%); JKM CFD rose to $24.09 (+1.39%, Trading Economics).

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.description: Iran and Oman advance a temporary corridor and mine-clearance framework; a signed, monitored reopening restores traffic and lowers Brent toward $75-85, while Qatar's force majeure keeps LNG availability constrained into early November.

scenarios.label: Stress
scenarios.description: The corridor remains provisional and traffic stays selective under Iranian fees, sanctions pressure and residual mine and attack risk; Brent holds $85-105 and JKM stays elevated while Qatar's force majeure runs into early November.

scenarios.label: Tail
scenarios.description: A widened multi-front exchange, a failed framework or renewed tanker attacks could close the southern lane again and spill into Bab el-Mandeb; Brent returns to $105-135+/bbl and JKM moves above $30/MMBtu.
